recommendedRoute.label: RFQ handoff
recommendedRoute.reason: Ask buyers for product size, quantity direction, box structure, finish, insert requirement and target market.

buyerBrief: Product category and sales channel: retail gift, cosmetics set, candle, wellness, electronics accessory or promotional kit.
Box structure direction: folding gift box, rigid-style gift box, insert tray, sleeve, window or magnetic style if already decided.
Required finish direction: plain, printed, foil, emboss/deboss, soft touch, matte/gloss lamination or special paper direction.
Quantity direction and target market, without treating quantity as a fixed MOQ claim.
Artwork status: production-ready dieline, brand guideline, reference photo or early concept only.
boundaries: No fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, lowest price or guaranteed compliance is claimed.
No FSC, FDA, food-contact or customer case claim is added here.
This is an intent-correction and RFQ route asset, not proof of Google ranking or inquiry conversion.
